title: Transdiagnostic efficacy, durability, and optimal parameters of rTMS for cognitive rehabilitation: A comprehensive meta-analysis
title_zh: 跨诊断性重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）在认知康复中的疗效、持久性与最佳参数：系统综述与荟萃分析
abstract: AIM: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS) is a promising non-invasive neuromodulation technique for cognitive rehabilitation. We evaluated the cognitive effects of rTMS on neurological and psychiatric diseases to determine moderators of efficacy. METHODS: A meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs) comparing real versus sham rTMS to July 2025 was performed. Objective cognition reported as primary or secondary outcomes were extracted and Hedges' g effect sizes computed. Univariate and multivariate three-level meta-analyses were performed to estimate pooled effect sizes and assess moderator influence. RESULTS: 748 measures from 137 studies (5972 participants) were extracted. Real rTMS produced a significant cognitive enhancement (g = 0.28, p < 0.0001, I2 = 37.3%). This was durable over 2-52 weeks follow-up. There was efficacy across all cognitive domains (g > 0.20, I2 = 35.8). Neurodegenerative (g = 0.35) and focal (g = 0.44) conditions demonstrated stronger effects than psychiatric conditions (g = 0.20). Although stimulation target was not a significant moderator overall, the Inferior Frontal Gyrus showed the largest effect (g = 0.45), with significant effects also at the left and right DLPFC and left parietal cortex (g = 0.29-0.45), all nodes of the Frontoparietal Network. 1-Hz stimulation produced a significantly larger effect (g = 0.39) than the 10-Hz reference (g = 0.19); 5-Hz, 20-Hz and iTBS were also significantly positive (g = 0.30-0.49). In multivariate models, adding 10 rTMS sessions improved cognitive outcomes (Δg = +0.077), whereas increasing the number of pulses per session trended toward reduced efficacy. All effects were confirmed in a left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex subgroup analysis. Subjective cognition was measured in only 6% of studies. A multivariate prediction tool is introduced: https://amsali.shinyapps.io/tms_cognition_prediction/ CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis demonstrates the sustained efficacy of rTMS in enhancing cognitive function, with small-to-moderate effect sizes across diverse clinical populations and stimulation protocols. However, a significant gap remains regarding whether these objective neurocognitive gains translate into meaningful improvements in subjective cognition or functional outcomes.
abstract_zh: 目的：重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）是一种有前景的非侵入性神经调节技术，用于认知康复。我们评估了rTMS在神经和精神疾病中的认知效应，以确定疗效的调节因素。方法：对截至2025年7月的随机对照试验（RCT）进行荟萃分析，比较真实rTMS与安慰剂rTMS。提取了作为主要或次要结果的客观认知指标，并计算Hedges’ g效应量。采用单变量和多变量三层次荟萃分析估计合并效应量并评估调节因素。结果：共提取了137项研究（5972名参与者）的748个测量值。真实rTMS产生了显著的认知提升（g = 0.28，p < 0.0001，I² = 37.3%）。该效应在2–52周随访期间保持稳定。所有认知领域均显示疗效（g > 0.20，I² = 35.8%）。神经退行性疾病（g = 0.35）和局灶性疾病（g = 0.44）的效应强于精神疾病（g = 0.20）。虽然刺激目标总体上不是显著调节因素，但下额叶回显示出最大的效应（g = 0.45），左、右背外侧前额叶皮层和左顶叶皮层（g = 0.29–0.45）也有显著效应，均为前额顶网络的节点。1 Hz刺激产生的效应显著大于10 Hz参考（g = 0.39 vs. 0.19）；5 Hz、20 Hz和iTBS也显著正向（g = 0.30–0.49）。在多变量模型中，增加10次rTMS会话可改善认知结果（Δg = +0.077），而每次会话的脉冲数增加则趋向于降低疗效。所有效应在左背外侧前额叶皮层亚组分析中得到确认。仅有6%的研究测量了主观认知。本文还引入了一个多变量预测工具：https://amsali.shinyapps.io/tms_cognition_prediction/。结论：本荟萃分析证明了rTMS在提升认知功能方面的持续疗效，在多种临床人群和刺激方案中均呈现小至中等效应量。然而，客观神经认知收益是否能转化为主观认知或功能结果的显著改善，仍存在显著空白。
